Emmanouela

A psychologist in Heraklion for children, teenagers, adults and families

Welcome to my space.

Here, every person has the chance to be heard, to understand themselves and to find ways to stand with strength and balance in the face of life’s challenges.

As a psychologist, my aim is to create a safe and accepting environment where you can express yourself freely and we can work together on whatever is troubling you — anxiety, emotional difficulties, relationship problems or matters concerning children and the family.

Through our work together we aim for emotional balance, self-awareness and a better quality of life — with respect, trust and authenticity.

  • Respect
  • Trust
  • Authenticity

Every step towards understanding yourself is a step towards change.

A few words about me

I am Emmanouela Papa, a psychologist based in Heraklion, Crete. I work with children, teenagers, adults and families who are looking for support, understanding and real change in their lives.

My aim is to offer a safe and accepting space where everyone can speak freely and explore what is difficult for them — anxiety, emotional pressure, difficulties in relationships, or challenges concerning children and the family.

Through counselling we work together to strengthen self-awareness, build resilience and improve quality of life. Every session is a step closer to understanding yourself and to a more balanced everyday life.

Caring for yourself is where every real change begins.

Services

Psychological support for every season of life

Individual sessions for teenagers and adults, parent counselling, support for children, children’s groups, couples and family counselling.

Keep scrolling→

01

Individual counselling

Counselling for teenagers & adults

Adolescence and adult life bring challenges such as anxiety, pressure and difficulty handling emotions. Here you have the space to speak freely and to stand with confidence.

  • Managing anxiety & emotions
  • Building confidence & self-awareness
  • Better relationships & communication
02

For parents of children & teenagers

Parent counselling

Parenting does not come with instructions. A safe space to understand your child’s behaviour, improve communication and handle tension, change or conflict.

  • Targeted techniques & practical tools
  • A bond of trust & security
  • Supporting healthy emotional development
03

Emotional & behavioural difficulties

Support for children

Many children find it hard to put what they feel into words — so they show it through their behaviour. Support helps a child recognise their feelings and build self-esteem.

  • An individual plan for each child
  • Creative methods: play, drawing, storytelling
  • Building social skills
04

For children with anxiety

Group programmes for children

Through play, hands-on activities and guided discussion, children learn to recognise anxiety, express it in healthy ways and develop relaxation skills.

  • Self-regulation & relaxation
  • More self-confidence
  • A sense of belonging
05

For couples at every stage

Couples & family counselling

Every relationship goes through difficult times. A safe space where each person can speak freely, be truly heard, and the bridge of communication can be rebuilt.

  • Communication with respect & empathy
  • Recognising patterns of behaviour
  • A stronger emotional connection

How we begin

Four steps, at your own pace

    A phone call

    Call 2810 543247 or 6944 526453, or send an e-mail. We find a time that suits you.

  2. 02

    Getting to know each other

New Mums

Pregnancy & motherhood

New Mums — support for expectant mothers, new mothers and future parents

Pregnancy and motherhood — on this journey you are not alone.

A support programme for expectant mothers, new mothers and future parents, with individual meetings, groups and couples counselling. Individual meetings can also take place at home when needed, as well as online.

During the programmes, mums learn

  • Ways of thinking and interacting with the baby, to build an emotionally and physically healthy reality
  • Useful information about pregnancy and the baby’s development
  • Ways to handle the stress of life
  • How to feel better and enjoy life with their baby

Group programmes

for expectant & new mums

  • A better physical & emotional experience of pregnancy
  • Positive mood & wellbeing
  • A stronger bond between mother & baby

8–12 people, in person or online · prevention groups for stress & postnatal depression 5–8 people

Couples counselling

for future parents

  • Handling the new challenges of everyday life
  • Real involvement of dads in pregnancy & the first months
  • Better teamwork between the couple

For the couple, before and after the birth

Individual sessions

for the mother-to-be & the new mother

  • Learning strategies to manage stress
  • Preventing postnatal depression

At the office, at home when needed, or online

FAQ

What people usually ask before the first session

Have another question? Call — it is the simplest way.

2810 543247
Where is the office?

At 96A Knossou Avenue, 2nd floor, Heraklion, Crete (postcode 713 06). Directions and the map are at the bottom of the page.

What are your hours?

Monday to Friday, 10:00–13:00 and 17:00–20:30, always by appointment.

How do I book a session?

Call 2810 543247 or the mobile 6944 526453, or e-mail emmapapa.psych@gmail.com.

Who do you work with?

With children, teenagers and adults, with parents, couples and families, and with groups — and, through New Mums, with expectant and new mothers.

What is Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)?

A structured, evidence-based approach that looks at how our thoughts, feelings and behaviour are connected, and gives practical tools for difficulties such as anxiety.

Can we meet online?

In the New Mums programme, individual meetings and groups can also take place online. For other sessions, call us and we will see what suits you.

What happens in the first session?

We get to know each other and talk about what brings you, at your own pace. By the end you will know how we could continue — with no obligation.

What is the New Mums programme?

A programme for expectant mothers, new mothers and future parents, with groups of 8–12, couples counselling, individual sessions and supportive groups for preventing postnatal depression (5–8 people).
